run_ijepa_training: run the I-JEPA training loop using a YAML config file and specified GPU devices
run_multigpu_training: run multi-GPU training by spawning processes for each device with the process_main function
load_config_yaml: load a YAML config file and parse training parameters with yaml.FullLoader
init_distributed_training: initialize distributed training with init_distributed using rank and world_size arguments
run_with_custom_devices: run the training process on custom CUDA devices using the --devices CLI argument
